rv.q: The result is a fine portrait of a flawed hero.
But if this Henry V does not end the season in a blaze of glory, it’s a conclusive vindication of an enlightened project.
With this Henry V, Grandage isn't exactly going out on a high. Though several scenes delight, others feel flat.
Jude Law has bravely returned to the stage to give an intriguing and at times entrancing new rendering of a very familiar role.

cn.t: Jude Law delivers a complex, human portrayal of the king in Grandage's efficient but traditional production that prioritizes character over contemporary relevance. Critics praise Law's maturity and contradictions while noting the staging lacks bold vision.
